title: Generation is correct but too far, could've placed it where the right example arrow points too, but if the space wasnt enough we wouldn't force it and place it behind the laptop

reading.marked: Frame EXAMPLE 0:04.63: a blue arrow, drawn from upper left to lower right, ends just above the teal pouch on the counter at the base of the white fridge. No text on this frame. Its zoom (under the frame) shows the same arrow, with its tip at the fridge's lower door seam directly above the pouch on the counter. Frame RIGHT 0:04.83: a green arrow starts just above the laptop's keyboard near its back edge and runs down and to the right, ending on the dark desk surface in front of and to the right of the laptop base. A green box labelled 'here' sits at the lower left of the frame, away from the arrow. Its zoom shows the same green arrow from the keyboard to the desk, with 'here' at the left.
reading.right_version: The RIGHT frame at 0:04.83 as generated: the green arrow marks a spot on the dark desk surface in front of and to the right of the laptop base, closer to the camera than the fridge. The pouch is not seen at that spot in this frame; it stays on the counter by the fridge.
reading.product_and_scene: The product is the teal Neuro Energy & Focus pouch (P3 Extra Strength Peppermint 90-piece pouch, per the sample header); its label and form match the product sample: a light teal pouch with a white top area. In the scene it is small, about a seventh of the fridge's height, standing on the counter at the fridge's base. The scene is a kitchen-living room with a black laptop in the foreground left, a dark water bottle beside it, a man in a blue jacket seated at right holding a phone, and a white fridge in the background. The camera is handheld, portrait, at seated height, and the same framing is used in both frames.
